name: Utö local loops
description: Weather-selected local paddles around Utö from Aktiv Skärgård, including Kyrkviken, Järnholmssund, Ängsholmen, Barnens Bad and Mysingen beaches.

waypoints.name: Kyrkviken
waypoints.notes: Sheltered regardless of wind according to findings.

waypoints.name: Ängsholmen
waypoints.notes: Outer corner can have swell after strong wind.

launchNotes: Aktiv Skärgård rents kayaks and gives weather-based route advice.

safety.exposure: Mixed sheltered and exposed options; Utö Runt for experienced paddlers only.

campingRules: Utö reserve camping only at designated places. Verify current rules.

protectionRules.summary: Utö local routes can touch Ålö-Rånö reserve on extensions; fires/camping/dog rules and shallow marine protection need route-specific checking.

generalRules.rule: Do not disturb or damage nature; avoid private zones and sensitive bird/wildlife areas.
Nature reserves, national parks, bird/säl protection areas and municipal reserves can restrict camping, fires, dogs, landing and anchoring.
Always check current Stockholm County fire bans before using any stove, grill or open fire.

rules: Do not tent more than two consecutive days except at designated places.
Do not anchor away from jetties/harbours more than two consecutive days.

seasonalRestrictions.restriction: Fishing prohibition noted by Länsstyrelsen; paddlers should avoid disturbing shallow spawning/nursery waters.

needsFollowup: Verify exact current protection boundaries against Naturvårdsverket Skyddad natur map before public navigation/import.
Create separate route variants and measure distances.
caveats: Route geometries are approximate waypoint corridors, not GPX tracks and not navigational advice.
Facilities use approximate point coordinates when exact rack/harbor/building coordinates were not available in the source record.
Keep original sources and needsFollowup fields attached during import.

route.warning: Approximate waypoint corridor for planning context only. Do not use this line for navigation.
